notes.title: Total update 22-02-24
notes.content:
We have done a lot of work to make the game even more realistic and nostalgic.
The new mechanics of shots makes the game much more intuitive. The computer now analyzes the trajectory of the mouse, so that the direction of the strike, the force, the slice and the spin are determined by the movement of your hand. Feeling of a presense - as never!
You can play now with AI Partner to practice your skills befor inviting friends or random rivals.
We are waiting for your comments and suggestions to make the game better.
Yours sincerely,
Doctor Mouse
